card.fact_statement: The holotype specimen of Ardetosaurus includes the left tibia.
card.source_span: The bones referable to MAB011899 comprise cervical vertebrae 13–14, dorsal vertebrae 1–10, several ribs, part of the sacrum, the left ilium, the pubes and ischia, the first five caudal vertebrae, two chevrons, the left coracoid, the partial left femur and fibula, the left tibia.

card.fact_statement: The holotype specimen of Sidersaura includes a braincase fused to the skull roof.
card.source_span: The holotype specimen, MMCh-PV 70, belonging to a mature individual, consists of a braincase fused to the skull roof
